 Sportsnaut Sun, October 25, 2026 at 3:25 PM UTC The NFL is considering 10 games outside the United States next season, up from nine this year, and that number could grow to 16 a year alongside a possible 18-game regular season. The Steelers and Saints are set to play Sunday in Paris. Despite protests and reported clashes between demonstrators and police in France, the league's plans had not changed as of Saturday night Eastern time, and extra security was planned. Going past 10 international games would require consulting the NFL Players Association. Tokyo is on the list for next year or the year after, while an overseas franchise and a Super Bowl abroad remain distant possibilities.
